author: Architecture
purpose: Pass/fail expectation suite for the translation marker. Every case carries expect_fire AND expect_absent: the observed failures are false POSITIVES (an invented accent, a gender on the wrong entry, a stem-guessed lemma) as often as misses, and a suite without expect_absent misses half of them.
how_to_run: Send the item and learner_answer to the worker. A case PASSES when every expect_fire entry appears with the stated outcome AND no expect_absent rule is violated. Report per-case, never an aggregate score.
regimes: Run both marker regimes (with and without the 581-name menu) on the identical set, so the r159 change is measured rather than argued.
note: Tranche 1, authored not harvested. The more valuable half is the cases drawn from live faults, which are Housing\u2019s to add as they occur.

cases.learner_answer: Abbiamo mangiato la pasta ieri sera.

expect_absent.rule: no markpoint may have outcome miss

cases.why: A verbatim-correct answer. Every required bucket fires as a hit and nothing misses. If this one is not clean nothing below is interpretable.

expect_absent.why: the extra word is not a negation-placement fault

cases.why: Learner adds a word the reference does not have. The tested skill is still demonstrated correctly, so it is a hit; any extra observation goes to the can\u2019t-credit channel, not to a miss on the required bucket.

expect_absent.why: position was correct; one error must not fail two buckets

cases.why: One error, one miss. Gender agreement is wrong, position is right. The prompt rule against collapsing a single slip into two misses.

expect_absent.rule: no miss on any adjective_agreement bucket
expect_absent.why: the fault is lexical, not agreement

cases.why: Wrong word, right form. Prompt rule 12: wrong word is a vocabulary error and must never fire an agreement miss.

cases.learner_answer: Hanno vendere la loro macchina vecchia il mese scorso.

expect_absent.rule: vocabulary.it.vendere.* must not be a miss
expect_absent.why: they knew the word and mis-formed it; that is a grammar fault

cases.why: The mirror of the case above: right word, wrong form. Vocabulary hits, grammar misses.

cases.learner_answer: Ieri mattina ho incontrato Marco al supermercato mentre facevo la spesa.

expect_absent.why: proper nouns earn no vocabulary bucket, Architecture ruling 3

cases.why: Smith caught the live version of this: "ore" prefix-matched orecchio and "problemi" stem-matched proprio, writing vocabulary events against words the learner never saw. Any recurrence of stem-guessing shows up here.

cases.learner_answer: Marco mi vede al bar ogni mattina.

expect_absent.rule: overall.marks_awarded must not be multiplied by 0.9

cases.why: Spelling matches the reference exactly. The anti-hallucination guard: an invented accent error damages trust more than a missed one.

expect_absent.rule: no gender markpoint on an entry the learner did not write
expect_absent.why: the gemello/mobile resolver defect fired gender against an adjective entry

cases.why: Gender must follow the entry actually credited. The bare-id resolver picked the lowest-rank entry and landed gender on adjectives.

cases.learner_answer: Ha smesso di fumare l\u2019anno passato.

expect_absent.rule: no miss caused by passato instead of scorso

cases.why: The learner uses a different but correct word. Under the no-single-correct-version ruling this costs nothing; the tested skill is untouched.

cases.learner_answer: Sono andato a scuola a piedi ogni mattina prima di trasferirmi in un\u2019altra citt\u00e0.

expect_absent.why: the participle is correctly formed; the fault is tense CHOICE

cases.why: Prompt rule 5. The learner picked the wrong tense and spelled it correctly. That is one miss on choice, not a formation miss as well.

cases.learner_answer: Marco me vede al bar ogni mattina.
cases.why: Prompt rule 14, stated as a test. One wrong-form-but-correctly-placed clitic is exactly one miss.

expect_absent.rule: no miss on any expected_buckets entry the answer does not engage
expect_absent.why: ieri sera is dropped; buckets tied to it are blanks, attempted_credit 0

cases.why: The defining test of the expected_buckets contract. A shorter but correct answer must not be penalised for the buckets it simply did not reach.
The other half of the contract: engaged and wrong is a REAL miss. Without this case expected_buckets would be credit-only and marking would go soft.

cases.learner_answer: Anna saw him at the cinema yesterday.

expect_absent.why: an English answer on an en_it item is not attempted

expect_absent.rule: overall must be not_attempted, not a set of misses

cases.why: Direction awareness. The learner answered in the wrong language; that is one overall verdict, not a sweep of grammar misses.
